news.Title: 當沖11個月慘賠1.8億！他曾握50張台積電全沒了　股人阿勳揭投資3警訊
news.Content: 台股今（19）日開低走低，盤中受美股賣壓與資金撤退影響，一度重挫941.26點至46,170.00點，終場收在46,822.08點，下跌289.18點，總成交額達8,251億元。在大盤劇烈震盪之際， 當沖與槓桿交易風險 再度引發熱議。面對市場劇烈波動， 投資專家「股人阿勳」 分享前刑警高仁和沉迷股票當沖、傳出短短11個月虧損高達1.8億元的故事，提醒投資人，頻繁交易不一定能加速累積財富，反而可能因槓桿與資金壓力，賠掉多年累積的資產。 【玩當沖慘賠上億賣房保單 錯失50張台積電悔不已】 股人阿勳在臉書發文表示，最近看到《新聞挖挖哇》一段訪談，前刑警高仁和分享自己沉迷股票當沖的經歷，讓他相當有感。據相關節目內容與報導轉述，高仁和曾在短短11個月內因股票交易損失約1.8億元，為了填補資金缺口，甚至變賣房產、解約保單。 更讓股人阿勳感慨的是，高仁和據稱早年曾持有50張台積電（2330），後來卻因資金壓力而賣出。這段經歷也讓他反思，投資人若一味追求快速獲利，忽略交易風險與資金管理，即使曾經握有優質資產，也可能因過度交易而失去原本累積的成果。 股人阿勳看到這段經歷後深有感觸，他坦言，一個人最可怕的不是沒有賺錢能力，而是明明已經擁有很多，卻因為貪圖賺得更多、更快，最終連原本擁有的財富與生活都一併失去。 【當沖非萬靈丹 股人阿勳揭開3大投資陷阱】 針對當沖與過度槓桿的盲點，股人阿勳特別歸納出3大關鍵思考點： 1.多數人高估自身能力： 每天盯著股價跳動，容易產生只要抓對幾次波動就能快速致富的錯覺。然而交易越頻繁，不只增加交易成本，更大幅提升犯錯機率。 2.槓桿剝奪投資選擇權： 股票下跌不可怕，可怕的是「沒有時間等待」。一旦面臨融資、借款與周轉壓力，即便手中握有優質好公司，也會被迫在最低點砍倉離場。 3.保留成果才是真正贏家： 投資的初衷是讓生活更好，而非每天為股價漲跌心神不寧。若投資影響到家庭、健康與正常生活，即使一時賺到大錢也毫無意義。 【穩穩走才能走得遠 股人阿勳：現金與本金是關鍵】 面對台股近期的大幅波動，股人阿勳提醒，市場永遠都有下一次進場的機會，但本金、時間與家庭不一定有重來的機會。 「財富的累積需要時間，但失去控制的貪婪，可能讓你在很短的時間內失去一切。」股人阿勳強調，投資不需要追求一夕致富，在震盪盤勢中能夠控管風險、穩健走下去，才是資本市場裡真正的勝者。

news.Title: 外資賣超767億元連9賣　調節力積電4.64萬張居首
news.Content:
（中央社記者吳家豪台北2026年10月19日電）台股今天走勢震盪，盤中一度重挫逾940點，尾盤跌勢收斂，終場下跌289.18點，收在46822.08點。外資及陸資今天持續站在賣方，賣超新台幣767.42億元，連續9個交易日賣超，今天減碼晶圓代工廠力積電4.64萬張最多。

三大法人今天合計賣超台股899.54億元，呈現「外資大砍、投信力挺」的土洋對作格局；自營商賣超362.63億元，連8賣；外資及陸資賣超767.42億元，連9賣，累計提款台股超過7585億元；投信持續站在買方，買超230.51億元，連7買。

觀察台灣證券交易所公布的外資賣超排行榜，晶圓代工廠力積電 (6770) 遭賣超4.64萬張，高居賣超榜首；市值型ETF（指數股票型基金）元大台灣50 (0050) 以3.68萬張排第2名，玻纖布大廠台玻 (1802) 2.98萬張位居第3。

高股息與主動式ETF、半導體與記憶體相關族群也成為外資提款重點標的。外資賣超榜第4至10名依序為群益台灣精選高息（00919）、主動統一台股增長（00981A）、主動統一升級50（00403A）、金寶 (2312) 、鴻海 (2317) 、旺宏 (2337) 、元大台灣50正2（00631L）。

此外，權值股龍頭台積電 (2330) 今天遭外資賣超9834張，連續9個交易日遭減碼。

外資買超榜則聚焦鋼鐵、面板、傳產及民生消費族群，前10名依序為中鋼 (2002) 、友達 (2409) 、泰金寶-DR (9105) 、統一 (1216) 、和碩 (4938) 、寶成 (9904) 、興富發 (2542) 、統一超 (2912) 、台表科 (6278) 、和益 (1709) 。

news.Title: 大盤狂殺沒在怕！郭哲榮砸「5千份雞排」豪賭台股年底上5萬
news.Content: 財經中心／綜合報導 知名股市分析師「哲哲」郭哲榮又在社群開大絕了！他 19 日在 Threads 上霸氣放話：要是台股年底前沒站上 5 萬點，就要送出整整 5000 份雞排。這篇貼文一出，立刻狂吸超過 42 萬次瀏覽，底下網友瞬間排起長龍搶著卡位。 這場「雞排豪賭」的起因，其實是 10 月台股的一波雲霄飛車行情。加權指數在 10 月 6 日一度逼近 5 萬點大關，沒想到 19 日盤中直接殺到 46170 點，短短兩週回檔超過 3700 點，終場收在 46822 點、跌了 289 點。眼看大盤震盪，郭哲榮先是在原文寫下：「年底沒有五萬點，哲哲我考慮發雞排共五千份，夠大氣了吧」，還強調北中南都會發，但他自己覺得根本不會發到，隨後又補刀自嘲：「我也卡一個，卡一個賺我自己一個雞排」、「我這叫『對沖雞精』」。 郭哲榮在Threads表示，年底沒有5萬點就考慮發雞排共5000份。（圖／翻攝自Threads／s178178） 不過，「考慮」這兩個字立刻被網友抓包吐槽，要他「霸氣一點，把考慮兩個字拿掉！」哲哲二話不說直接乾脆加碼：「好啦，年底沒有五萬點，發雞排五千份啦！」，賭局一拍即合，留言區瞬間炸鍋！底下除了湧入一票網友狂刷「卡」、「我就知道你還有錢」，最關鍵的勝負規則也引來精明網友追問：到底是要 12/31 確定超過，還是曾經上去過就算？哲哲則大方給出標準：「有上過 5 萬點就算我贏了啦！」直接敲定只要年底前摸到就算數。 郭哲榮被網友嫌「考慮」二字不夠霸氣，隨即回覆「發雞排五千份啦」。（圖／翻攝自Threads／s178178） 至於大家最關心的哪裡能領，他幽默回了句「北中南都發，青發白都發」，連賣豆乳雞的哲粉都忍不住跑來留言，問他只發雞排該怎麼辦，更有店家直接附上高雄炸雞菜單毛遂自薦，場面熱鬧到讓人笑稱「雞都要移民了」。另外，還有粉絲敲碗希望他找立場相反的財經名嘴來場「多空世紀大對決」，哲哲則語帶保留地回覆：「最近國巨事件後，短期內，先不要見比較好」。距離年底還有一小段時間，台股究竟能不能一路衝破 5 萬大關？這 5000 份「對沖雞精」最後到底吃不吃得到，大家就等著看年底開獎了。 《民視新聞網》提醒您：內容僅供參考，投資人於決策時應審慎評估風險，並就投資結果自行負責。

news.Title: Morning Bid: Wavering waiver?
news.Content:
By Mike Dolan

Oct 19 (Reuters) - After a withering shakeout in AI-linked tech stocks last week, earnings reports from Meta and others due in the next few days will provide another opportunity to test the waters.

The severity of the selloff was exemplified by ‌the SOX chip index's more than 10% weekly loss, as well as the 25% drop in data center builder CoreWeave, which sat ‌at the epicenter of investors' concerns.

Among a range of AI anxieties, markets are starting to fret about the rising cost of capital for the big borrowers in the space, just at ​a time when the pace of revenue growth may be slowing and doubts are rising about the cost of computing that AI developers can eventually charge customers.

Meta - along with Tesla , Texas Instruments and others - will report third-quarter earnings this week, and close tabs will be kept on the scale of its investment spending growth ahead.

A big takeaway from last week's market action was how the Treasury bond market reacted to the stock market tumble, with yields retreating sharply on the ‌prospect of any damage to the overwhelming AI theme, ⁠even after unexpectedly hot US inflation readings for September.

That retreat continued first thing Monday as crude oil prices backed off five-month highs seen late last week. Brent crude hit $110 per barrel on Friday for the first time since May on ⁠concerns about worsening developments in the Iran and Ukraine-Russia wars.

Although the weekend did see more ships hit in the Gulf, as well as a Ukrainian attack on another major Russian oil installation in St Petersburg, the focus now shifts to US sanctions waivers on Russian crude in an attempt to get energy prices down before ​the ​midterms.

Russia may not have much to export given developments in the war, and there ​were weekend doubts from US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, ‌who said President Trump would use up to 60 days to assess the impact of waiving sanctions. Brent fell back 2% first thing Monday nonetheless.

Elsewhere, China reported that third-quarter GDP growth picked up to 4.5%, with softer retail sales growth beating forecasts for September too. The yuan hit another four-year high.

Indonesia's stock market, the worst-performing of the year, plunged again today after Friday's announcement by index compiler MSCI that it may remove the country from its emerging market investment indexes due to governance and transparency concerns.

Indonesia's stock benchmark is down more than 40% for the year so far.

CHART OF THE DAY

Rocket or ‌damp squib? Elon Musk's SpaceX will report on Tuesday, with consensus estimates homing in ​on $12.7 billion revenue and earnings of 14 cents per share.

news.Title: Tesla Costs More Than $350 a Share. Here's Why I'd Still Buy One.
news.Content:
Like the head-turning Roadster it reintroduced last week with some snazzy new performance features, Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA) shares come with a big price tag. The stock enters this week at $354.72.

Despite the triple-digit price of admission, now could be a good time to buy at least a single share. Even if your broker is open to selling you fractional shares, going with a round share is more than just a cleaner transaction. It provides you with full voting power and the ability to transfer to a brokerage account, which may not allow fractional purchases.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

It can fly

There's a lot going for Tesla stock these days. A surge in gas prices is boosting the value proposition of electric vehicles, reversing the bearish narrative that began for U.S. drivers in the fall of last year after federal tax credits of up to $7,500 for new purchases or leases expired.

The high-end Roadster is just one of the many new offerings coming from the world's most valuable automaker by market cap. Tesla's Optimus humanoid robots, improvements in its autonomous driving platform, and a push into commercial vehicles leave analysts expecting annual revenue to nearly double in the next three years.

Sticking the landing

A lot can also go wrong. Profitability was cut in half in its previous quarter . Analysts see a much smaller decline on the bottom line when it reports third-quarter results later this week, but it still needs to turn that around.

The top line has recovered quickly from last year's fourth-quarter decline, bringing us to today's opportunity. The shares are down 21% this year. The fundamentals are holding up better. Even as we head into Wednesday afternoon's financial update, analysts are bracing for flat sales. This is actually a good thing, since last year's third quarter was when sales spiked as U.S. buyers scrambled to get their orders in before the federal tax credit expired.

Tesla is out of favor with investors this year. Volatility has always been part of this story, but historically, as with its new Roadster Rocket, it's just a matter of time before it lifts off the ground.

But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout, a massive technology build-out that Google's CEO says could be more profound than fire or electricity.

While everyone watches the chip designers, one "backbone" company provides the critical technology that Nvidia and AMD literally cannot function without. We've detailed this under-the-radar player in our new AI Playbook.

news.Title: 預言台股年底5萬點！郭哲榮發祭品文：沒破發雞排5千份
news.Content:
由於通膨擔憂及AI過度投資疑慮，美股再次翻空，拖累台股連日重挫、回測季線，5萬點關卡攻勢受阻。對此，曾經預言台股今年會攻破5萬點的 摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮 稍早發出雞排祭品文，「年底沒有5萬點，哲哲我考慮發雞排共5千份」，不過他也強調覺得自己不會發到雞排，貼文曝光後引發熱議。

郭哲榮分析，台股今（19）日一度重挫超過940點，在過去2週不到回檔3千點，看起來很恐怖，但接近午盤時跌點開始收斂，郭哲榮坦言，很多人可能很絕望，他看到的卻是賺大錢的機會，郭哲榮點名，精材（3374）早已翻紅、環球晶（6488）跌幅大幅收斂，「十月最佳買點、甚至第四季最佳買點，我認為就在這週，光復節前這一週！」

郭哲榮認為，最近的利空很容易總結，就是解決美伊衝突，「我認為川普最快這週有機會與伊朗達成協議，機率有60%！」，屆時油價壓力緩解、通膨升息擔憂和企業債務壓力下降，對股市利多；個股方面，郭哲榮說除了精材（3374）、環球晶（6488），帆宣（6196）、微星（2377）、中美晶（5483）、國巨（2327）、華新科（2492）、華邦電（2344）、群聯（8299）都有機會。

郭哲榮提到自己還是看好台股發展，預言今年挑戰5萬點、明年挑戰6萬2千點、三年內挑戰10萬點，同時也在Threads發文指出，「年底沒有5萬點，哲哲我考慮發雞排共5千份，夠大氣了吧，北中南都發，但我覺得我不會發到雞排」。

news.Title: 摩根士丹利：美股拉回接近尾聲 投資人應準備逢低加碼
news.Content:
隨著美股科技股等類股歷經數月的修正，部分華爾街投資機構認為，市場拉回正臨近尾聲。

摩根士丹利首席股票策略師威爾森(Michael Wilson)及其團隊在最新研究報告中表示，儘管標普 500 指數距離歷史高點僅約 2%，但過去幾個月估值已有顯著回檔，同時基準指數的市場廣度有所惡化。

威爾森指出，先前優質因子(Quality Factor)表現勝過等權重指數的偏向即將結束，這將為投資人逢低加碼股票提供絕佳機會。

威爾森在致客戶報告中明確指出：「我們建議投資人做好準備，無論是迎接快速的調整，或是延續至 11 月的緩步整理，在我們看來，屆時都將是增加風險資產而非規避風險的時機。」他強調，此輪回檔屬於買進機會而非新一波熊市的開端。

在選股策略上，威爾森偏好基本面強勁且每股盈餘(EPS)成長動能上修的優質企業，特別是受估值修正影響較大的經濟敏感型類股(如資本財、金融與工業等)已創造出吸引人的進場點。

大摩報告特別推薦 Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、蘋果(AAPL-US)、博通(AVGO-US)、美光(MU-US)等龍頭個股，並預估主要雲端業者對 AI 的投資持續成長，2027 年將達 1.6 兆美元，明年 AI 資本支出將貢獻標普 500 成分股新增營收成長的四分之一。

另一方面，摩根大通策略師Mislav Matejka領軍的團隊指出，若公債殖利率持續趨穩，將有助於止住本益比收縮，減輕 AI 企業融資壓力，並為股市提供實質支撐。

Bull of the Day: Sandisk (SNDK)
news.Content:
There's an old saying on Wall Street that the trend is your friend. Well, when it comes to the technology sector, there are few trends more powerful than the artificial intelligence boom. We've seen the incredible run in NVIDIA and the companies building out AI infrastructure. But there's another corner of the market that has been absolutely on fire. I'm talking about memory and storage.

AI needs more than just powerful processors. It needs massive amounts of data, and that data needs somewhere to live. That's creating a tremendous opportunity for companies providing the infrastructure behind the AI revolution. One of those companies is today's Bull of the Day, Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) Sandisk ( SNDK ).

Sandisk develops and manufactures NAND flash-based storage products, including solid-state drives, embedded storage solutions, and consumer memory products. The company returned to the public markets as a standalone business in February 2025 following its separation from Western Digital. Since then, investors have been treated to an incredible rally as demand for high-performance storage has exploded.

Sandisk is in the Computer – Storage Devices industry, which ranks in the Top 10% of our Zacks Industry Rank. That's a very favorable backdrop for a stock already benefiting from some of the strongest growth trends in technology.

Sandisk Corporation Price and Consensus

Sandisk Corporation price-consensus-chart | Sandisk Corporation Quote

The numbers behind this company are nothing short of staggering. Sandisk recently reported fiscal fourth-quarter earnings of $39.25 per share, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 14.63%. Revenue surged 371.6% year over year to $8.97 billion, exceeding expectations by roughly 8%. Datacenter revenue jumped 103% sequentially to $2.98 billion as hyperscalers continued gobbling up storage capacity to support AI workloads.

That growth is translating into incredible profitability. Non-GAAP gross margins expanded to 84.6%, up from 78.4% in the previous quarter. Think about that for a second. This is a company selling storage products, yet it's generating margins that would make plenty of software companies jealous.

Revenue estimates tell a similar story. Analysts are looking for fiscal 2027 sales of $49.25 billion, up from $20.25 billion in fiscal 2026. That's more than 143% revenue growth. Fiscal 2028 sales are projected to climb another 19% to $58.46 billion.

The reason for the favorable rank is that over the last sixty days, analysts have upped the ante for both the current year and next year. The bullish moves have pushed up our Zacks Consensus Estimate for the current year from $192.82 to $213.31 and next year up from $181.88 to $252.80. The stock has had some pressure recently because of the financing questions popping up in the Neocloud space. This should eventually work itself out. While investors know the numbers can't grow like this forever, they should be enjoying the profits while they can.

Story Continues

news.Title: A big 'yikes' still hangs over the AI trade as Meta and Tesla report: What to watch this week
news.Content: Move over Wall Street, because it's tech's time to shine. After a busy first proper week of earnings that saw a relatively mixed picture out of the big banks, attention turns to the tech trade, where Meta ( META ), SpaceX ( SPCX ), and Tesla ( TSLA ) will all report results. With little economic data coming ahead of the Federal Reserve's late October meeting, the first batch of tech results will have our undivided attention. After a relatively quiet Monday, the week's major earnings get properly underway on Tuesday with SpaceX and Netflix ( NFLX ), where co-CEOs Ted Sarandos and Greg Peters are likely to face questions (scrutiny or praise, we'll see) over recent layoff announcements. Wednesday will see results from Tesla and Meta, set to provide an early read on the state of the Magnificent Seven and the AI trade writ large. Several of the so-called "prime" defense contractors — Northrop Grumman ( NOC ), Lockheed Martin ( LMT ), and RTX Corp. ( RTX ) — will also post their quarterly results, joined throughout the week by industrial heavyweight Honeywell ( HON ) and energy giant NextEra ( NEE ). The quiet economic calendar will feature a smattering of housing and labor market data ahead of Friday's consumer sentiment readings from the University of Michigan, which are likely to capture the most attention. Meta is 'back on offense' in AI When Meta reports third quarter earnings on Wednesday, Mark Zuckerberg and the company's other executives are likely to take myriad questions around one topic: the company's growing push into AI. The focus for Meta recently has, of course, been the launch of Muse Spark, a personal AI agent product that set off waves of bulls claiming agentic workflows will revolutionize whole industries and of bears claiming, basically, "No one wants this." The product immediately racked up millions of downloads, reaching the 5 million mark faster than OpenAI's ( OPAI.PVT ) ChatGPT, Anthropic's ( ANTH.PVT ) Claude, and SpaceX's Grok. The product launch — one of Meta's largest announcements in years — has put the company " back on offense with AI, " argue Bank of America analysts Justin Post and Nitin Bansal, who have a Buy rating on the stock with an $810 price target. "We think Muse and Model traction can drive multiple expansion with stock at 22x 2027 EPS," the analysts wrote. There are some risks for Meta, Post and Bansal said. Muse downloads and activity could slow down, and Google could release a competitor consumer agent product that would take market share away from Meta. Story Continues Comments from executives on the upcoming earnings call could stoke fears around a potential capex slowdown — or speed-up, with growing expenses — as market watchers look for any crack in hyperscaler growth projections. Even so, the BofA analysts are expecting good things. For the third quarter, consensus estimates put Meta's adjusted earnings for the quarter at $6.76 per share with revenue of $63.35 billion, within the company's guided range of $61 billion to $64 billion. Post and Bansal are more bullish, estimating revenue of $63.8 billion. If nothing else, Wednesday's earnings report is set to be a check on a quote from Mark Zuckerberg that was published by Meta alongside the company's second quarter report: "AI is accelerating our core business today, powering our next generation of products, and opening the door to entirely new enterprise opportunities. The results are already showing, and I'm optimistic about the potential ahead." Tesla's earnings call is another chance to hunt for SpaceX merger news After a two-week delay, the Tesla ( TSLA ) Roadster event went off with a massive bang — a flying one. As our colleague Pras Subramanian reported, Tesla's new Roadster EV on Thursday night cruised halfway up an inverted half roller-coaster ramp erected at SpaceX's facility in Waco, Texas, launched off the ramp upside down, and performed flips in the air, using air thrusters to right itself and land on the tarmac. It also jumped over a row of other Tesla vehicles. " There were hints that the Tesla Roadster might do something extraordinary, but I think what happened in Texas on Thursday evening far exceeded everyone's expectations," said Henry Catchpole, host of Hagerty's "The Driver's Seat," who was in attendance at the event. All that said, even as the event gave Tesla stock a boost, the new Roadster probably won't be the deciding factor in the company beating on earnings. Still, the high-profile reveal on Thursday night did achieve two things. "Two takeaways from tonight's Roadster event. 1. It was an engineering flex with no commercial value beyond embarrassing traditional car makers. 2. Elon can't wait to bring $TSLA and $SPCX together," veteran tech analyst Gene Munster said in an X post. As Munster points out, the event immediately sparked renewed conversations around a potential tie-up between SpaceX and Tesla , which would bring Musk's two public companies under one umbrella — and give him just about full control of the combined entity, considering he's the dominant shareholder in SpaceX. Musk and his team have been careful not to make any leading statements on the matter, even though it's been publicly documented Musk indeed wants to merge the companies. Regardless, the demonstration is certain to spark questions about a tie-up when Musk speaks with analysts and investors after SpaceX and Tesla each report earnings. Oh, and we'll also be watching for robot news and Robotaxi updates. CoreWeave's neocloud financing 'yikes' hangs over the AI trade It was a bloody week for the semiconductor trade, triggered by a chart posted to X and a one-word reply from Elon Musk: "Yikes." The chart in question showed spiking yields on bonds issued by the neocloud provider CoreWeave , prompting a renewed wave of concerns about the company's debt-heavy balance sheet and whether it can scale its business quickly enough to cover rising interest expenses. The debate over CoreWeave gets at a broader point that's been coursing through discourse around the AI trade recently. Buying semiconductors, renting compute capacity, training and operating LLMs — all of those activities are extraordinarily expensive. Increasingly, the financing for that capex has come not from cash stores, but from the debt market. That's prompted fears that if there were to be a rerating of the AI trade, investors could get stuck holding the bag. In every successful technological revolution, there are always winners and losers. CoreWeave's ( CRWV ) credit risk reached an all-time high on Thursday, per data from the Intercontinental Exchange, reflecting investors' rising concerns over the feasibility of the debt profile at the leading neocloud provider. The price of CoreWeave credit default swaps, essentially a form of insurance against default risk, rose by 74.5 basis points to price in 60% odds that the company will default on its debt within the next five years, per Bloomberg. At the same time, some of CoreWeave's bonds continued to slide further, as 9% notes fell to trade at 80.75 cents on the dollar with a yield of 15.3% as investors demand a premium to hold the debt. CoreWeave has defended its financing model, arguing in a statement to Yahoo Finance, "When you are building a new type of technology company there will be periods of time when the market misunderstands and acts irrationally." The stock also staged a recovery through the week, prompted by a statement of confidence in the company from Nvidia ( NVDA ) CEO Jensen Huang. That said, Nvidia holds a sizable stake in CoreWeave. For bearish investors, that's part of the problem. news.Title: Prediction: Microsoft Stock Is Going to Soar After Oct. 28
news.Content:
Volatility gripped the stock market last week amid concerns about the sustainability of the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure spending boom. The S&P 500 experienced a modest decline, but it continues to trade at a historically expensive valuation, so strong corporate earnings will be necessary to keep this bull market going.

As a result, all eyes are on the current reporting season. Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) will release its operating results for its fiscal 2027 first quarter (ended Sept. 30) on Oct. 28, and Wall Street will be squarely focused on the Azure cloud platform and Copilot virtual assistant, which are central to the company's AI strategy.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Microsoft stock is attractively valued heading into the report, so here's why I predict it will climb in the weeks and months that follow.

Positioned to lead the enterprise AI race

AI is a powerful tool in an enterprise because it can dramatically improve productivity by automating tasks, analyzing large volumes of data, and even generating content like images and computer code. Microsoft is helping businesses tap into the power of AI through Copilot and Azure, and both represent enormous opportunities for the company.

The Copilot assistant is embedded in Microsoft's legacy software products like Windows and Edge for free. But enterprises can also add it to the 365 productivity suite (which includes Word and Excel) for an additional monthly subscription fee. As of June 30, organizations worldwide were paying for 30 million Copilot licenses for 365, a staggering 50% increase from just three months earlier.

However, organizations pay for more than 400 million 365 licenses for their employees, so Copilot adoption is still in the very early stages. Investors should keep an eye out for some updated numbers on Oct. 28.

Then there is the Azure cloud platform, which provides every tool enterprises need to deploy AI software applications. That includes computing capacity from specialized data centers, more than 11,000 ready-made foundation models, and a platform called Foundry where they can design and manage custom AI agents.

Microsoft built 88 new data centers during fiscal 2026 as part of a two-year plan to double its global infrastructure footprint. This will help Azure convert its enormous $678 billion in remaining performance obligations (RPO) into revenue, which effectively represents the platform's order backlog from customers who are waiting for more infrastructure to come online.

Story Continues

Azure's revenue growth accelerated to 43% in the final quarter of fiscal 2026, so the platform was carrying significant momentum into the fiscal 2027 first-quarter earnings report. A further acceleration will be very bullish for Microsoft stock, but so will growth in the company's RPO, because it can be a good indicator of future revenue.

Microsoft stock could soar after Oct. 28, but there is one caveat

Based on Microsoft's fiscal 2026 earnings of $17.95 per share, its stock is trading at a price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio of 30.1, which is a discount to its five-year average of 32. Plus, the stock has a forward P/E of 27.3 based on Wall Street's average fiscal 2027 earnings estimate of $19.78 per share (provided by Yahoo! Finance), leaving even more room for potential upside.

MSFT PE Ratio data by YCharts

Nevertheless, the AI industry faces increasing doubts right now that could jeopardize Microsoft's ability to actually deliver on Wall Street's fiscal 2027 earnings estimate. Labs like OpenAI and Anthropic are facing questions about their valuations and growth rates, which could reduce their ability to raise more money from investors. Moreover, neocloud companies like CoreWeave are dealing with a surge in borrowing costs on concerns they won't be able to deliver on their lofty future projections, which could weigh on the stock market overall.

OpenAI has committed to spend more than $300 billion on Microsoft Azure's cloud services during the next few years, but it doesn't actually have that money today. OpenAI will have to increase its revenue significantly and also raise more money to meet all of its commitments, so if it fails on either front, Microsoft's RPO could take a hit.

For all of those reasons, the first-quarter earnings report is likely to set the tone for Microsoft stock for at least the next few months. I think there could be upside ahead based on its attractive valuation, and the sheer size of its RPO –- even if we exclude OpenAI's contribution entirely, Azure is still likely to be backlogged for the next couple of years. However, investors might want to manage their risk by using a small position size given the uncertain environment.

news.Title: Five things to watch in markets in the week ahead
news.Content:
Investing.com - Artificial intelligence is in the spotlight once again as the trading week gets underway, as traders fret over a combination of mounting debt loads in AI companies and potentially higher-for-longer interest rates. Against this backdrop, the quarterly earnings season accelerates, with results due out from hyperscaler Meta Platforms, rocket giant SpaceX, electric vehicle maker Tesla, and streaming player Netflix.

Still guessing which stocks will beat the market? Our AI portfolio updates monthly and is outperforming the S&P 500 by 118%. See this month's list »

1. AI jitters in focus

The week begins with investors focusing on recent jitters over the AI boom.

Partially fueling these fears was hotter-than-anticipated September inflation data, which increased expectations for higher U.S. interest rates. Worries have subsequently abounded over the sustainability of large-scale debt-driven spending by AI companies on a rapid buildout of AI infrastructure like chips and data centers.

Shares of semiconductor and technology hardware firms have slumped as a result, casting a pall over an AI-driven bull market that has now marched on for four years. Last week, the Philadelphia semiconductor index, a tracker of the sector, retreated by 11.41%, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite shed 4.48%.

Data center operator CoreWeave was at the heart of the selloff, with the stock shedding roughly a fourth of its value last week alone. Cloud computing group Oracle also declined by 9.31% for the week, while the cost of insuring against defaults in these companies' bonds soared.

"Clearly the main nervousness last week was around AI-related names, with credit markets starting to show some distress in that sector," analysts at Deutsche Bank said in a note.

2. Meta to kick off hyperscaler earnings

A parade of tech-sector earnings this week could provide more color on the trajectory of runaway AI expenditures.

Highlighting the earnings schedule is Meta Platforms, which will report after the closing bell on Wednesday. Over the last month, the Facebook-owner has taken large strides in the race to harness AI, thanks to a well-received release of its new Muse AI model.

Muse amassed millions of downloads after the product was launched in September, underlining demand for its various services, including help with booking travel and setting up small business tools. Meta has since moved to expand the reach of the technology, releasing an open-weight version of its Muse Spark model for coding.

Story Continues

Meta will be the first of the so-called AI "hyperscalers" to report. These megacap companies have been pushing to quickly develop their AI capabilities, in part by raking in chips and quickly constructing data centers. The spending has helped to underpin the broader AI industry, in the process.

3. SpaceX to report

Unsure what to buy ahead of earnings? Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. See this month's earnings picks »

Elsewhere, Elon Musk's SpaceX will report after the market close on Tuesday.

The company, which went public in a blockbuster flotation earlier this year, successfully placed its Starship rocket into orbit for the first time in September. An updated version of its Starlink satellites was deployed as well, underscoring SpaceX's progress toward using its experimental rocket across a variety of applications.

This month, SpaceX has also announced a deal to purchase cellular spectrum licenses from Grain Management, an investment group. Reportedly worth about $8 billion in cash for assets, the move was seen as a push by SpaceX into the wireless market, threatening the hegemony of telecom industry giants like T-Mobile and Verizon.

4. Tesla earnings ahead

Musk's electric car manufacturer Tesla will also report following the close of the U.S. markets on Wednesday.

On Thursday, Tesla unveiled a redesigned Roadster which used SpaceX rocket technology to jump off a ramp and perform a controlled landing. Musk said production of the long-awaited vehicle was set to begin in 2028, over a decade after it displayed a next-generation version of its electric sports car.

The company debuted the model in a live event at SpaceX's McGregor, Texas test facility. The vehicle was able to climb a curved ramp at a controlled pace and jump the ramp at a full inversion before using its air thrusters to correct its orientation and land on all four wheels. Tesla also had the car jump and fly over a set of parked cars and a semitruck.

5. Netflix earnings on tap

Meanwhile, Netflix is due to report after the close on Tuesday.

Last week, the streaming titan reportedly said it planned to slash around 6% of its workforce, or roughly 1,000 roles. The jobs impacted would mostly be in the firm's product, legal, tech and human-resources units, the Wall Street Journal reported.

It was the biggest round of job reductions at the company since 2022. At the end of last year, Netflix employed about 16,000 workers.

The move comes as Netflix is grappling with easing customer engagement after years of strong growth that put intense pressure on traditional cable television businesses. A failed bid to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery's streaming and studio assets earlier this year has also exacerbated concerns around the group's overall strategy.

news.Title: 美股財報季前逢賣壓　亞股收盤互有漲跌
news.Content:
（中央社香港2026年10月19日綜合外電報導）市場對AI投資熱潮的疑慮日益加深，引發美股賣壓，但隨著企業財報即將公布，投資人逢低買進，為市場提供部分支撐，亞股今天收盤互有漲跌，首爾股市揚升1.8%。

法新社報導，市場憂心通膨飆升、成本攀升，以及近年來投入人工智慧（AI）產業的龐大資金何時才能帶來回報，晶片商及其他與AI相關企業股價再度面臨賣壓。

投資人正關注至關重要的美股財報季，科技巨頭特斯拉（Tesla）和Meta都將於本週公布財報。

美國聯邦準備理事會（Fed）下週利率決策也備受關注。在美國通膨數據高於預期後，市場押注聯準會將連續第2次升息。利率上升不利於科技公司，因為許多企業仰賴借貸，支應鉅額投資。

美股3大主要指數上週五收盤全面重挫，那斯達克綜合指數跌幅超過2%，微軟（Microsoft）、輝達（Nvidia）、超微（AMD）及亞馬遜（Amazon）等大型企業股價下跌，拖累指數表現。

這股賣壓今天也蔓延至亞洲，東京股市日經225指數受到科技投資巨頭軟銀（SoftBank）、以及愛德萬測試（Advantest）、東京威力科創（Tokyo Electron）等企業股價表現拖累。

不過，受惠於晶片製造商SK海力士（SK hynix）與三星電子（Samsung Electronics）股價走強，首爾股市攀升1.8%。

亞洲其他股市方面，雪梨和上海股市走高，威靈頓及台北股市則下跌。香港股市因假日休市。

news.Title: 台積電熊本二廠2028年底生產3奈米 JASM設備投資總額將超過230億美元
news.Content:
台積電(2330-TW)及其日本子公司JASM提出的熊本二廠生產計畫變更申請，獲日本政府核准，將改為生產3奈米製程邏輯晶片，隨著計劃的調整，JASM設備投資總額預計將超過230億美元。

根據日本媒體報導，日本經濟產業省16日宣布，核准台積電及JASM提出的熊本二廠生產計畫變更申請，熊本二廠預計2028年12月開始生產，月產能為6000片。

台積電日本官方X帳號發文表示，衷心感謝日本政府對JASM第二工廠計畫所給予的支持。該工廠計畫採用3奈米製程技術生產尖端半導體，JASM的設備投資額合計預計將超過230億美元。

台積電表示，具體的生產與投資計畫將根據市場需求分階段實施，並以獲得日本政府支持為前提，持續研議相關計畫。未來，JASM將持續與合作夥伴攜手，運用兼顧環保的創新綠色製造技術，為日本及全球客戶提供尖端技術，以因應AI時代的強勁需求。

台積電熊本二廠原先規劃生產6至12奈米製程晶片，月產能為4.8萬片，另也計畫生產40奈米晶片，但考量AI帶動的強勁需求，因此改採3奈米製程技術生產，台積電董事長魏哲家也於今年2月拜訪日本首相高市早苗時告知。

news.Title: The Trillion-Dollar AI Bet: What It Means for Hyperscaler Investors
news.Content:
It's hard to wrap your head around the amount of money that's flooding the artificial intelligence (AI) industry. According to research compiled by Vanguard, the five major hyperscalers, which includes Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL) (NASDAQ: GOOG), Microsoft , Amazon , Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META), and Oracle , will spend almost $780 billion on capital expenditures (capex) in 2026, up 87% year over year. This is just the start.

Over each of the following four years, from 2027 through 2030, that figure will exceed $1 trillion annually. This is more than 10 times greater than the combined capex of these five companies in 2020.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

The trillion-dollar AI experiment is happening right before our eyes. Here's what it means for hyperscaler investors.

Owning these stocks means taking on heightened financial risk

There's no doubt that these businesses present investors with more financial risk than at any point in recent history. As a group, their debt burdens are soaring. Alphabet and Meta Platforms provide a clear example.

As of June 30, Alphabet carried $98.2 billion in long-term debt. This was 568% higher than exactly four years ago, which was before OpenAI released ChatGPT.

As of June 30, Meta Platforms carried $83.7 billion in long-term debt. It had no debt on the balance sheet four years earlier.

That borrowing, of course, is going toward funding AI investments. The result of this capex is that free cash flow (FCF) is taking a huge hit. Alphabet reported negative FCF of $5.9 billion in Q2, while Meta Platforms' FCF fell 91% year over year. Analysts expect both businesses to burn cash in 2027.

At the same time, the leadership teams of these two internet pioneers have paused share buybacks. Capital returns to investors have been redirected to data centers.

The financial risk is high. Investors must be more patient than before.

Nobody knows what comes next

The other side of the capex equation is return on invested capital (ROIC). The biggest question in the economy and markets is what payback investors in these five hyperscalers can expect from the unprecedented spending that's taking place. Timing is also a huge unknown variable. It wouldn't be a surprise to see ROIC come down as these companies transition from capital-light enterprises to capital-intensive ones.

Story Continues

It doesn't matter what the experts predict. No one knows how this will all play out. History provides some context.

During the spending booms that occurred in the 1870s (railroads), the 1920s (electricity), and the 1990s (telecom), the result was overbuilt capacity that resulted in a bust. The infrastructure didn't go to waste, however. It was eventually used to enable the creation of entirely new businesses, products, and services that weren't possible before.

That's not a prediction that a bust will or won't happen this time around. But it's important to know what history tells us.

Investors shouldn't be surprised if adequate returns, expressed as positive and rapidly growing FCF, take longer than expected to arrive. Moreover, it's possible that most of the value eventually moves away from the hyperscalers, whose cloud platforms could become commodities, toward businesses that dominate the market for differentiated end-customer products and services.

Bain & Company estimates that "by 2031, annual spending on AI infrastructure could reach $1.5 trillion." Based on a 25% capex-to-revenue ratio, the consulting firm calculates that the AI economy will need to generate $6 trillion in revenue yearly to justify the capital outlays. About two-thirds of that $6 trillion is projected to come from innovation that doesn't yet exist.

A successful outcome likely means that nearly every business and consumer uses AI in their daily lives within the next five years. If you own any of these five hyperscaler stocks, that's the future that you're betting on. This is something investors can't afford to overlook.

news.Title: 野村投信最新台股看法--【台股操盤人筆記】AI短線雜音難免，基本面仍是最大底氣
news.Content: 加權股價指數近6個月表現：（資料來源：Bloomberg，截至2026/10/14） 野村腳勤觀點： AI短線雜音難免，基本面仍是最大底氣 近期市場擔憂中國長鑫存儲擴產恐加劇記憶體供給壓力，但中國廠商目前仍難以取得最先進的EUV設備，即使技術有所突破，若無法有效提升量產良率，技術再好也是枉然，因此我們評估此事件對整體記憶體市場衝擊相對有限，而目前台廠記憶體現貨與合約價格仍存在一倍以上的價差，營收與獲利仍有望逐季成長。被動元件方面，MLCC第二季已針對通路商調漲過一波價格，而大型ODM客戶今年以來尚未調漲價格，預期今年Q4至明年Q1將迎來新一波漲價，幅度約10%～30%。目前股市位居高位，任何風吹草動都可能成為短線回檔理由，市場焦點也逐漸從題材與資金追捧，轉向企業營收、訂單能見度及產品規格升級等基本面議題。Vera Rubin逐步進入實際出貨階段，相關供應鏈同時受惠拉貨放量與產品單價提升，基本面支撐將更加明確，仍是後續台股布局重點。 經理人視角： 大盤利多因素： （一）AI資本支出強勁：四大CSP 2027年資本支出上修至1兆美元，AI基礎建設的投資循環尚未見頂 （二）Vera Rubin出貨：預期Q4末~明年Q1初進入大量量產階段，相關供應鏈可望看到月營收顯著成長 （三）獲利上修趨勢不變：野村投信內部股票池估計2026年EPS YoY上修至77.3%，連續第9個月上修 大盤利空因素： （一）評價面仍有壓力：Fed進入升息循環、美債殖利率突破5.3%，短線或為評價面帶來壓力 （二）CSP自由現金流轉負：短期對資本支出影響應屬有限，但若加速惡化，或影響未來資本支出節奏 行情進入財報驗收期，聚焦兩大關鍵 隨著S&P 500企業進入第三季財報公布高峰，AI相關股票也迎來獲利檢驗，近期盤面震盪未必代表趨勢反轉，而是股價累積可觀漲幅後，市場更關注企業獲利能否跟上。接下來將關注兩大重點：一是四大雲端服務供應商(CSP)的資本支出在法說會公布後是否有調整，二是本週(10/15)台積電法說會；由於今年AI相關資本支出大致已經底定，市場焦點轉向明年資本支出能否進一步上修，以及AI需求是否持續強勁。只要四大CSP持續加碼AI投資，台積電對需求與擴產展望也維持樂觀，就代表AI成長動能仍有基本面支撐，即使短線受到財報或評價壓力干擾，也無須因一時的股價震盪而過度擔憂AI長期趨勢。 閱讀更多精彩文章 【野村投信贊助刊登】

news.Title: 《陸股》滬指漲0.39%、日K翻紅；科創50跌2.17%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-19 17:11:00 數位內容中心 發佈

中國A股三大指數今(19)日震盪分歧，上證指數收於3,730.92點，上漲14.64點或0.39%，日K翻紅；深證成指收於11,817.42點，上漲14.96點或0.13%；創業板指收於2,746.29點，下跌26.09點或0.94%；科創50收於1,329.19點，下跌29.46點或2.17%。盤勢先開低後回升，顯示指數雖有修復，但成長類股壓力仍較明顯。

成交量方面，滬市今日成交6,870億元(人民幣,下同)，深市成交7,505億元，兩市成交額1兆4,375億元，較前一交易日量縮約8%。

從盤面上來看，人形機器人概念走強，宇樹科技午後漲幅擴大，兆威機電、浙江榮泰、福萊新材等個股漲停。PCB族群同步活躍，四會富仕、肯特股份、協和電子等漲停。

此外，銀行族群逆勢走強，工商銀行盤中股價創歷史新高，建設銀行等跟漲。電力族群同樣偏強，江蘇新能、浙江新能等漲停，顯示資金在防禦與題材之間快速切換。

相較之下，農業、算力硬體、半導體、醫藥生物與房地產等族群承壓，金健米業、萬向德農等走弱。整體來看，今日A股呈現「指數修復、結構分化」格局，強勢集中在少數主題。

news.Title: 外資賣超767億！ 網見「這檔」連2天買超居冠：是挖到礦喔
news.Content:
台股今（19）日盤中一度重挫逾900點，最低下探46,170點，所幸尾盤在台積電拉抬下跌勢收斂，終場仍下跌289點。其中外資及陸資賣超767.42億元，賣超力積電逾4.6萬張居冠；另一方面，中鋼則是連2個交易日獲外資買超第一名，引發網友熱議，直呼「是挖到礦喔」。

外資買超前10名

依據PTT網友轉貼的上市外資買賣超排行，外資買超第一名為中鋼（2002），買超10,021張；第二名是友達（2409），買超8,761張；第三名為泰金寶-DR（9105），買超6,718張。其後依序為統一（1216）6,665張、和碩（4938）6,064張、寶成（9904）5,744張、興富發（2542）4,900張、統一超（2912）4,194張、台表科（6278）3,967張，以及和益（1709）3,843張。

值得注意的是，中鋼連續受到外資青睞，讓股民忍不住追問原因。有網友留言「中鋼是挖到礦喔」，也有人問「為什麼中鋼連二日買超第一名？」另有網友調侃「買中鋼是為了賣中鋼」，對外資操作方向感到疑惑。

外資賣超前10名

賣超方面，力積電（6770）以46,465張居首，元大台灣50（0050）遭賣超36,892張，台玻（1802）賣超29,813張，群益台灣精選高息（00919）賣超24,668張，主動統一台股增長（00981A）賣超24,593張。

排名第六至第十名依序為主動統一升級50（00403A）22,435張、金寶（2312）15,609張、鴻海（2317）14,884張、旺宏（2337）13,979張，以及元大台灣50正2（00631L）13,706張。

此外，台積電（2330）也遭外資賣超9,834張，其他如華新、南亞、元大高股息及台塑化等個股同樣位列賣超名單。電子股遭調節的情況，成為股民討論焦點，有網友直接抱怨「賣三小台積電」，也有人留言「華崩電一直賣一直賣」，反映市場對外資調節電子股所造成的憂慮。

（封面圖／東森新聞）

news.Title: 台股震盪考驗選股功力，00400A近3月績效居台股主動式ETF同類基金之冠
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】近期國際科技股賣壓升溫，台股走勢亦受到影響，對此，主動國泰動能高息（00400A）基金經理人梁恩溢表示，當市場對AI投資效益的檢視更加嚴格，選股不能只看產業題材，更須重視企業能否將訂單需求轉化為獲利，以及股價評價是否合理。00400A透過企業研究與靈活調整投資組合，尋找具備成長潛力的企業，近三個月績效居台股主動式ETF同類型基金之冠。根據投信投顧公會資料顯示，00400A近三個月報酬率達7.91%，在20檔台股主動式ETF基金中勇奪第一，近六個月報酬率更達60.08%，於14檔同類基金中排名第四，兩項績效均位居同類型基金前段班。除了績效亮眼外，截至10月16日00400A資產規模已突破300億元，躋身主動式ETF規模前段班，受益人數亦達13.9萬人，展現商品在主動式ETF市場的發展成果。

梁恩溢表示，00400A不集中押注單一強勢產業，而是從不同領域尋找具競爭優勢的企業，選股著重企業獲利成長、產業競爭力及股價評價，並依據市場趨勢與企業營運變化調整投資組合，兼顧成長機會與投資價值。隨著AI產業從晶片、伺服器延伸至散熱、電力及高速傳輸等領域，各環節的成長步伐不盡相同，投資組合也須隨產業發展適時調整。00400A透過持續追蹤企業營運與市場評價，評估不同產業的投資機會，兼顧成長潛力與配置彈性。

針對近期市場對AI基礎建設的融資成本、槓桿程度及投資效益疑慮升溫，外資賣壓也牽動台股走勢，梁恩溢表示，從企業營運表現觀察，台灣科技產業的成長動能仍有實際數據支撐。根據財政部統計，今年9月出口金額達872.2億美元，年增60.9%，其中資通與視聽產品出口較去年同期成長約一倍，電子零組件亦年增45.3%，反映AI、高效能運算及雲端服務需求持續帶動台灣供應鏈。台積電上週公布第三季稅後盈餘年增68.7%，也顯示相關需求對企業獲利的貢獻。隨著市場更加重視AI投資效益，企業能否維持獲利成長及產業競爭優勢，將是後續投資布局的重要觀察方向。

根據國泰投信官網，截至10月16日，00400A主要布局包括台積電(2330)、聯發科(2454)、台光電(2383)、南亞(1303)、欣興(3037)、奇鋐(3017)等企業，投資範圍涵蓋半導體、客製化晶片、高階銅箔基板、PCB及散熱等領域。

news.Title: 《韓股》低接買盤簇擁 KOSPI開低走高收漲1.76%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-19 16:41:02 數位內容中心 發佈

韓股今(19)日先受美國AI與半導體股重挫拖累，早盤一度明顯下挫，但終場KOSPI與KOSDAQ指數在機構買盤支撐下雙雙翻紅，韓國KOSPI指數收於5,768.01點，上漲99.96點或1.76%；韓國KOSDAQ指數重返800點整數關卡、收於808.89點，上漲14.11點或1.78%，盤勢由恐慌性賣壓轉向低接承接。

外部壓力方面，市場開盤即反映美國科技股急跌後的風險外溢，投資人持續關注AI基礎設施投入能否帶來足夠回報。這類疑慮一度壓低韓股早盤表現，也讓半導體與AI鏈成為最先承壓的方向。

此外，機構進場低接為盤勢反彈的主要動能，大型股在急跌後獲得承接，帶動指數自盤中低點逐步收復失土。權值股與類股方面，KOSPI指數中，Samsung SDI(006400.KS)、LG Energy Solution(373220.KS)、Samsung Biologics(207940.KS)、Hyundai Motor(005380.KS)與KB Financial Group(105560.KS)走強，電池、製藥與化學族群成為主要撐盤力量。

news.Title: 台股殺聲隆隆別急抄底！專家籲做3件事：恐不只跌1天
news.Content: 台股今（19）日迎來「黑色星期一」，受美股科技股賣壓襲擊影響，開盤即開低走低，盤中一度狂拉警報重挫941.26點至46,170.00點，終場收在46,822.08點，下跌289.18點，跌幅0.61%，總成交額為8,251億元。 《Smart智富》月刊社長林正峰 在開盤前即於臉書粉專《峰哥的投資思考筆记》發文提醒投資人「先把安全帶繫好」，並強調這次回檔恐怕不會只跌1天，呼籲大眾務必先做好「3件事」來防範市場風險。 【美股科技股殺聲隆隆 華爾街追問AI回本期】 林正峰在開盤前分析指出，美股留下來的訊號極為沉重，美科技股連番大砍，那斯達克指數重挫2.15%，費城半導體指數單週更暴跌超過11%，台積電（2330）ADR也持續走低。當美股從科技股開始撤退，高度依賴半導體與AI供應鏈的台股自然難以獨善其身。 林正峰表示，AI並非突然失去前景，而是市場開始懷疑價格。過去華爾街視AI為上漲保證，如今卻開始追問：「砸下數千億美元興建資料中心，究竟要多久才能回本？」在融資成本居高不下的背景下，法人資金轉向檢視自由現金流與資本支出，也讓高本益比個股面臨估值修正壓力。 【夜盤大跌千點預警 慎防強勢股連環補跌】 早在開盤前，16日台指期夜盤大跌1,144點、收在46,140點的訊息，就已預示了今日現貨市場的震撼教育。今日盤中台股一度重挫941.26點，驗證了期貨市場提前反映的沉重賣壓。 林正峰特別提醒，當市場成交量急速放大、融資賣壓湧現時，原本僅是外資調節的行情，極易演變成集體去槓桿的停損潮。特別要留意開低之後若持續破底，連原本強勢的股票也開始補跌，代表賣壓尚未消化完畢。 【應對黑色星期一 專家提醒先做3件事】 面對台股急跌震撼，林正峰呼籲投資人在面對波動時，應先做好以下3件事： 1.不要把急跌當撿便宜： 股價跌了10%不代表不會再跌，尤其高本益比AI概念股，估值修正幅度往往超乎想像。 2.檢查槓桿與現金： 持有元大台灣50正2（00631L）等正二ETF、融資股票或期貨部位者，務必嚴控風險，避免被迫砍在最低點。 3.避免開盤情緒性交易： 切忌第一時間盲目抄底或恐慌砍倉，應觀察賣壓能否消化、台積電（2330）是否止穩及外資動向。 林正峰強調，面對市場波動，去槓桿與保留現金才是保全資金的關鍵，切勿因一時恐慌而進行情緒化操作。 三立新聞網提醒您：

news.Title: Should You Buy, Sell, or Hold META Stock Before Q3 Earnings Release?
news.Content:
Meta Platforms META is set to report its third-quarter 2026 results on Oct. 21.

For the third quarter of 2026, Meta Platforms expects revenues between $61 billion and $64 billion. The forecast assumes foreign currency will create an approximately 1% headwind to year-over-year revenue growth.

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for the third quarter of 2026 revenues is pegged at $63.24 billion, suggesting a year-over-year increase of 23.42%. The consensus mark for earnings stands at $6.54 per share, down 1.94% over the past 30 days, suggesting a decline of 9.79% from the figure reported in the year-ago quarter.

Factors to Note

Meta Platforms' third-quarter performance is expected to have benefited from strong advertising demand, improving user engagement and continued adoption of artificial intelligence (AI)-powered advertising solutions across its Family of Apps. The company's investments in AI-driven recommendation systems are expected to improve content discovery and increase user engagement across Facebook and Instagram. In the second quarter of 2026, advertising impressions increased 14% year over year, while the average price per ad rose 12%. These trends are expected to have supported advertising revenue growth in the to-be-reported quarter.

The company's growing adoption of AI-powered advertising solutions, particularly Advantage+, is expected to have driven advertising revenues. Advantage+ surpassed $75 billion in annual revenue run rate in the second quarter of 2026. Improvements in AI-powered ad ranking, conversion optimization and creative generation are expected to have strengthened advertiser returns and support advertising spending in the to-be-reported quarter.

Increasing engagement across Instagram, Facebook, Threads and WhatsApp is expected to have benefited META's third-quarter performance. AI-driven content recommendations and Reels improvements are boosting user engagement and monetization opportunities. Expanding advertising on Threads and WhatsApp, along with growing adoption of paid messaging and business agents, is expected to have created additional revenue opportunities.

Meta Platforms' expanding AI ecosystem, supported by Muse models and Meta AI, is expected to have strengthened user engagement and advertising effectiveness in the quarter to be reported. Growing adoption of AI creative tools, Meta Business Agents and subscription offerings is likely to have benefited the company's top-line growth in the to-be-reported quarter.

However, rising infrastructure investments, AI-related spending and operating expenses are expected to have pressured third-quarter profitability. Higher depreciation, data center expenses and AI talent costs could constrain margins. Foreign currency headwinds and ongoing regulatory challenges are additional concerns.

Story Continues

META Shares Underperform Sector; Valuation Stretched

META shares have rallied 7.5% year to date (YTD), underperforming the Zacks Computer & Technology sector's 15.8% gain.

However, META's shares have outperformed its peers in the advertising space, which includes Alphabet GOOGL, Amazon AMZN, and Snap SNAP. While Snap shares have plunged 24%, Alphabet and Amazon shares have gained 8.8% and 8.3%, respectively, in the year-to-date period.

META Valuation

META Leverages AI to Boost Growth, Higher Capex Hurts

META's long-term growth prospects are supported by its expanding AI ecosystem, growing enterprise opportunities and investments in next-generation computing infrastructure. The company is investing in advanced AI capabilities through Meta Superintelligence Labs, focusing on developing increasingly sophisticated models that can power next-generation consumer and enterprise applications.

The company's expanding enterprise AI initiatives are expected to drive long-term revenue growth. Meta Platforms is developing AI-powered coding and productivity tools, expanding its Muse Spark API offerings and exploring opportunities to monetize computing capacity directly. These initiatives are expected to diversify revenues beyond advertising and strengthen its presence in the rapidly growing enterprise AI market.

The company's investments in custom silicon, data centers and network infrastructure are expected to strengthen its competitive position. Meta Platforms is prioritizing computing capacity expansion through 2027 while establishing infrastructure foundations to support growth in 2028 and beyond. Its strategic venture with BlackRock to develop a 1-gigawatt data center in Texas further supports these expansion plans.

However, elevated capital expenditures remain a major concern. Meta Platforms expects 2026 capital expenditures between $130 billion and $145 billion, reflecting aggressive investments in AI infrastructure, data centers and computing capacity. These investments are expected to increase depreciation, infrastructure operating costs and financial commitments, potentially pressuring margins and free cash flow.

Meta Platforms acknowledges that AI and Reality Labs investments are reducing cash flow, operating margins and profitability and expects spending to continue increasing. Reality Labs reduced 2025 operating profit by approximately $19.19 billion, and 2026 Reality Labs operating losses are expected to remain similar to 2025 levels.

Conclusion

Meta Platforms appears well-positioned heading into its third-quarter 2026 earnings release, supported by strong advertising demand, expanding AI capabilities and improving user engagement. However, elevated capital expenditures, margin pressure and premium valuation remain concerns. Meta Platforms' third-quarter 2026 results and management's commentary on AI spending, capital allocation and monetization progress will likely play a crucial role in determining the stock's near-term direction.

news.Title: 〈陸股盤後〉 中國Q3經濟成長反彈至4.5% 三大指數漲跌互見
news.Content:
中國A股三大指數周一（19日）收盤漲跌互見，中國第三季經濟成長加速，且優於經濟學家預期，提升了達成北京當局全年目標的機率，也降低了政府推出額外寬鬆措施的可能性。

上證指數周一收報3,730.92點，漲0.39%。深證成指收報11,817.42點，漲0.13%。創業板指收報2,746.29點，跌0.94%。

根據中國國家統計局周一公布的數據，第三季國內生產毛額（GDP）年增4.5%，增幅大於第二季的4.3%，亦優於經濟學家預測的4.4%。

這使得今年前九個月的經濟擴張幅度達到4.6%，落在政府設定的4.5%至5%全年目標區間。

經濟的反彈應能給政策制定者一些喘息空間，使政府官員得以暫緩推出更多寬鬆措施，目前政府官員仍受到銀行利差收窄以及地方政府持續面臨財政壓力的限制。

此外，9月工業生產年增率加速至 5.5%，符合經濟學家預期。零售銷售反彈幅度遠超預估，來到 1.1%，8月僅成長0.4%。

今年前九個月固定資產投資縮減7.2%，降幅與前八個月相同。

儘管近幾個月中國經濟放緩加劇，政府官員最初仍聚焦於落實既有促成長政策，直到三周前才加大支持力道，推出一項新的定向措施。

這個世界第二大經濟體的成長呈現兩極化：一方面是受到全球人工智慧（AI）投資超級周期的帶動，出口表現極為強勁；另一方面則是家庭支出疲軟，投資亦長期欲振乏力。

此外，就業市場降溫，長達數年的房市低迷也在持續拖累國內經濟。

疲弱內需使中國的經濟成長日益依賴出口。這讓北京面臨的貿易夥伴壓力越來越大，貿易夥伴要求中方解決龐大貿易順差問題——今年這項數字預計將打破2025年創下的 1.2 兆美元紀錄。

歐盟正準備賦予自身新權限，可能允許其封鎖中國進入歐盟單一市場的管道，作為雙邊貿易重新平衡的一環。

與此同時，外國領袖已呼籲北京當局允許人民幣更大幅度的升值，指出人民幣被低估，給予中國出口商不公平競爭優勢。

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》新式核能—CEG、VST、LEU
news.Content:

Constellation Energy（CEG.US）

10月6日，Constellation Energy宣布投入超過43億美元，升級Illinois、New Jersey與Pennsylvania共6座核電廠、11座反應爐，預計為PJM新增890MW核能容量。Google已就這批新增容量簽下20年期購電協議，首批新增電力預計於2028年交付。

Vistra（VST.US）

本週，Vistra取得美國能源部最高42億美元有條件貸款承諾，用於Beaver Valley、Davis-Besse與Perry核電設施升級。該案預計維持接近4GW基載核能供應，並新增433MW發電容量，重點在既有核電增容與延壽。

Centrus Energy（LEU.US）

本週，Centrus Energy與Antares Nuclear簽署多年期高含量低濃縮鈾（HALEU）供應協議，交付將於本十年結束前開始，且包含客戶預付款。這使其本週訊號集中在先進反應爐最關鍵的燃料供應鏈落地，而非單純產能規劃。

Oklo（OKLO.US）

本週，Oklo獲美國能源部旗下National Reactor Innovation Center納入Nuclear Energy Launch Pad，推進Groves-2 Forge醫療同位素專案。DOE本輪共選出12家開發商、13個新專案，顯示其布局已由發電延伸至同位素生產、處理與純化。

NuScale Power（SMR.US）

本週，NuScale Power的主題訊號仍集中在已核准設計向正式部署推進。其77MWe設計已建立在美國核能管理委員會（NRC）核准基礎上，羅馬尼亞Doicești的RoPower專案規劃6座模組、總裝置容量462MW，但目前仍未見具約束力的正式建造訂單。

NANO Nuclear Energy（NNE.US）

10月13日，NANO Nuclear Energy更新KRONOS MMR在NRC的建照申請進度。該案已於5月18日正式受理、6月23日啟動正式審查，NRC公開時程目標在2027年9月完成final Safety Evaluation，公司維持2027年下半年展開初始建設活動的規劃。

Uranium Energy Corp.（UEC.US）

本週，Uranium Energy Corp.成立National Security Advisory Council，強化公司向鈾轉換領域擴張。公司同時公布截至7月31日的2026財年全年鈾產量為229,294磅，並出售400,000磅U3O8，顯示其重點正轉向本土核燃料供應鏈延伸。

news.Title: 外資連九賣台股，新台幣匯率承壓，週一再貶1.07角收32.445元
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】台北外匯市場週一新台幣兌美元匯價走貶，市場對AI產業發展的擔憂在上週五衝擊美股，費城半導體指數連續八天殺跌，台股週一重拾跌勢，加權指數收跌0.61%，外資賣超上市股票達767.42億元，為連續九天淨賣超，給予台幣不小的壓力。新台幣兌美元匯率週一以32.445元作收，與前一交易日比較，台幣匯率貶值1.07角。銀行間新台幣兌美元最高成交價為32.360元，最低成交價落於午後為32.572元，成交量為28億3,100萬美元。

市場分析師表示，短線持續關注上週大舉賣股的外資動向。同時，有關AI交易的全球市場擔憂導致台幣走弱，但這掩蓋了台灣經濟基本面的韌性，而這些基本面因素有利於台幣在年底前反彈。

news.Title: 台股震盪別急著抄底！周代運點名「 4大觀盤重點」
news.Content:
台股今（19）日開低走低，盤中一度重挫941.26點，最低下探46170點，終場跌幅收斂至289.18點，收在46822.08點，跌幅0.61%，成交金額8251億元。面對台股劇烈震盪， 市場資深分析師周代運 提醒，接下來除了觀察 美債10年期殖利率 ，也要留意 新台幣匯率、AI供應鏈輪動 及 期貨籌碼變化 ，操作上不宜滿倉，應保留現金因應行情變化。

【美債殖利率牽動台股 外資動向成觀察重點】

周代運指出，本週（10月19日至23日） 首先要觀察美國10年期公債殖利率走勢。 若長天期美債殖利率持續走高，可能加重新台幣貶值壓力，進而影響外資資金流向，讓台股反彈力道受到限制。

他提醒，投資人不能只看台股K線判斷進出場時機， 也要把匯率變化納入觀察 ，尤其當美債殖利率、台幣匯率與外資動向同時出現不利變化時，更要留意市場波動風險。

【PCB、CCL漲多震盪 ABF載板、HBM看訂單】

在 族群輪動 方面，周代運認為，CCL銅箔基板、PCB印刷電路板相關個股，經過前一波漲勢後，若成交量逐漸萎縮，股價可能進入較長時間的整理階段，投資人不宜只因先前強勢就追價。

相較之下， 高階ABF載板及HBM高頻寬記憶體相關封裝測試，仍是值得追蹤的方向 。不過，他提醒，不能只要掛上輝達供應鏈或AI概念就認定具有長期投資價值，還是要檢視實際訂單能見度、合約價格、產能排程及獲利表現，才能判斷企業是否真正受惠。

【HBM需求強勁不代表股價必漲 留意利多反應】

記憶體族群同樣是本週觀察焦點。美光（Micron）近期宣布，台灣新設的先進封裝與測試廠2027年規劃產能已全數售罄，反映AI應用對高頻寬記憶體的需求持續強勁。

不過，周代運提醒，產業基本面看好，不代表股價就會一路上漲。若市場已提前反映利多，股價卻無法跟著走強，投資人就要提高警覺，並同步觀察美股記憶體類股表現及利率變化，避免只憑產業題材追高。

【台指期多空快速切換 散戶別盲目追單】

除了現股表現，周代運也提醒投資人留意 台指期未平倉結構 。他指出，近期自營商在期貨市場頻繁進行多空操作，可能以短線價差為主，不能直接解讀為看好或看壞後市的長線訊號。

在多空快速切換的行情中，若投資人只因大盤上漲就急著放大期貨多單，可能面臨行情反轉、停損接連觸發的風險。期貨具有槓桿特性，操作前應先評估自身風險承受能力，避免把現股操作思維直接套用在期貨交易。

【鋼鐵股可分散波動 周代運：操作別滿倉】

周代運也提到，自己在訂閱文章中持續關注鋼鐵族群，主要是將其視為分散科技股波動的配置

news.Title: 三大法人賣超900億 台股只跌289 網：不容小覷
news.Content:
台股今（19）日盤中一度重挫逾900點，最低下探至46,170點，回測季線附近，所幸尾盤在台積電強勢拉抬下，跌勢有所收斂，終場下跌289點，收在46,822點，跌幅0.61%，成交量約8,200億元。三大法人合計賣超899.54億元。

根據證交所公布，外資及陸資今日賣超767.42億元。自營商方面，自行買賣賣超60.22億元，避險操作賣超302.40億元，兩者合計賣超362.62億元，投信則逆勢加碼230.50億元。

觀察投信買超個股，力積電（6770）以買超12,774張居冠，其次為群益ESG投等債0-5（00985B），買超8,078張；玉山金（2884）買超7,138張，元大台灣50（0050）買超5,054張，合庫金（5880）買超4,706張。其他投信買超標的還包括第一金（2892）、台新新光金（2887）、台積電（2330）、友達（2409）及彰銀（2801）。其中，台積電獲投信買超3,878張，成為今日尾盤支撐指數的觀察焦點之一。

投信賣超方面，華航（2610）以賣超4,443張居首，緯創（3231）賣超4,226張，長榮航（2618）賣超3,970張，元大金（2885）賣超3,012張。其餘賣超個股包括和碩（4938）、國巨*（2327）、統一（1216）、華南金（2880）、華邦電（2344）及凱基金（2883）。

台股今日盤中一度重挫逾900點，終場卻僅下跌289點，加上三大法人合計賣超近900億元，盤面表現與法人賣超金額形成反差，引起PTT網友熱烈討論。不少網友都在問「誰在買？」、「到底誰在買？」，針對外資及自營商大舉賣超、指數卻能從盤中低點拉回感到不解。也有網友表示，「三大賣900億，跌200點」，認為台股承接力道不容小覷。

news.Title: 美股延長交易吸走台股資金？金管會：關注後續影響
news.Content:
（中央社記者蘇思云台北2026年10月19日電）外界關注美國那斯達克交易所將延長交易時間到23小時，是否可能吸走台股資金，金管會主委彭金隆今天表示，金管會已成立專案小組針對資本市場議題做多方研議，後續密切關注美國新制上路後的影響與成效，台灣若要調整交易時間，必須取得社會共識才會做。

美國兩大交易所那斯達克（NASDAQ）與紐約證券交易所（NYSE）規劃延長交易時間至每日23小時、每週交易5天的近全天候交易模式，其中那斯達克將於12月6日正式上路，開始實施夜盤交易。

立法院財政委員會今天邀彭金隆率所屬機關首長列席業務報告並備質詢。國民黨立委羅明才關切，美國延長交易時間是否會產生磁吸效應，吸走全球資金與人才，台灣是否有因應策略。

彭金隆表示，美國那斯達克交易所預計12月6日起把盤後7小時納入交易，主要是那斯達克交易所面臨其他交易所與替代交易系統（ATS）競爭，希望可以涵蓋全球不同時區的投資人，爭取更多交易機會。

不過，他表示，延長交易也可能增加營運成本、非正常交易時段成交量可能偏低，價格發現功能也未必與正常交易時段相同，金管會將密切觀察美國新制相關成效。

至於台灣是否要跟進延長交易時間，彭金隆表示，各國交易制度不同，不需要照抄美國作法。目前觀察亞洲市場，僅韓國小規模延長盤後交易，許多市場仍在觀望。

國民黨立委李彥秀關心，台灣有沒有可能從現行交割「T+2」制度改為「T+1」，也關心美國延長交易時間，台灣資本市場是否跟進。

彭金隆表示，近期國際資本市場有許多變化，金管會先前組成專案小組研議，包括延長交易時間、「T+2」交割制度等，不過交易時間延長與否，台灣先取得社會共識才會推動。

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》高密度/頻寬記憶體—NVDA、MU、TSM

SK hynix（SKHY.US）

10/15路透報導，美國商務部已改為逐案核准SK hynix中國廠採購美國設備，原則上不批准擴產或技術升級所需設備。這項變動直接牽動其大連NAND廠設備引進節奏，公司也表示後續將依美國政府協商結果與許可要求推進。

Micron Technology（MU.US）

10/15台灣經濟部公布，Micron Technology以約94.49億美元貨幣債權增資台灣子公司，成為2026年前9月核准僑外來台投資大增的主要來源。這筆增資直接對應其持續強化在台動態隨機存取記憶體（DRAM）與先進記憶體營運基礎。

ChangXin Memory Technologies

10/18報導指出，ChangXin Memory Technologies正推進4F²記憶體單元、垂直環繞閘極電晶體（VSG）與混合鍵合（Hybrid Bonding），並計畫在2026年底前推出雙倍資料速率第五代（DDR5）伺服器記憶體。其本週訊號在於高密度DRAM技術路線加速，焦點先落在標準型DRAM與伺服器記憶體。

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company（TSM.US）

SanDisk（SNDK.US）

SanDisk先前已與SK hynix發布Open Compute Project技術規格，並由Google與Tenstorrent參與驗證與標準化，目標是讓高頻寬快閃記憶體（HBF）可與HBM協同用於AI系統。這是本週少數把高密度NAND直接連到AI記憶體架構的具體進展。

news.Title: 名師操盤》台股急殺後反彈訊號浮現 9檔潛力股上車機會來了
news.Content:
儘管上周美國公布的9月CPI與PPI雙雙高於市場預期，一度升高市場對聯準會繼續緊縮的擔憂。不過，聯準會主席華許在IMF年會表示，近期經濟發展「大致符合」9月會議時的預期，因此並未釋出急於升息的訊號，FedWatch顯示本月升息機率反而降至約12%，這代表高通膨仍會壓抑科技股評價，但利率預期沒有同步轉鷹，也替市場提供部分緩衝。而美股上周五延續修正慣性，標普500下跌1.1%、那斯達克下跌2.1%，因此台股今天仍反映部分壓力。

不過若細看台積電ADR的密集成交區，其實正好就在目前位置，換言之前一段時間的攻高，現在已收斂至市場平均成本的匯集區，短期可留意是否出現跌深反轉。而台指期貨成交量分布也正好來到45500至46500點的密集成交區，雖然短線大盤應該是很難一口氣呈現A轉向上，但從籌碼結構來看，本周站在「反彈」角度的勝率相對較高；若後續搭配外資回流、台幣走升，則短線落底的機會也會隨之提高。

族群方面，PCB展即將登場且族群部分於上周五率先回溫，AI伺服器對高階板材、載板與高速傳輸的需求仍是中期支撐。金像電、欣興可作為族群強弱的主要觀察指標，南電、臻鼎-KY也值得同步留意，重點在反彈後能否持續放量並突破前高。另外，PTFE族群在上周表現相對強勢，由於PTFE具備低介電損耗特性，市場預期可應用於AI伺服器高速傳輸與新一代交換器板，因此帶動相關材料股開始轉強。台虹、台郡可作為主要觀察指標，亞電、騰輝電子-KY可同步留意，甚至鑽孔的凱崴也有望同步受惠；不過目前部分產品仍在驗證或產能建置階段，後續仍須觀察訂單與營收能否跟上題材。

整體而言，本周會先以「反彈」的格局來做看待，若後續權值股明顯回穩，同時重點族群領先過高，則會視為落底訊號浮現；同時再搭配Q4回測，最低點往往也出現於10月，因此現階段拉回理當會視為是第四季的上車機會。

news.Title: 一度重挫941點逼近季線 台股跌289點收46822
news.Content:
[ 非凡新聞 ]記者黃友柔,攝影謝隆証

台股今（19）日開盤急跌，指數最低下探46170點，下跌900多點，面臨季線保衛戰，不過11點過後跌幅明顯收斂，尤其台積電最後一盤有買單敲進，股價收盤守在平盤價2420元，因此台股終場僅下跌289點，收在46822點，只是成交金額縮小至約7735億元。籌碼方面，三大法人周一合計賣超899億元，其中外資提款767億。對於近期大盤波動劇烈，周一財委會上有立委關心是否出動「限空令」，對此，金管會主委彭金隆表示，尊重市場機制，除非市場失靈。

金管會主委 彭金隆：「什麼時候政府要介入，一定這個是失去市場功能的時候。我們有漲跌幅的限制，我們也有處置股的概念。」

近期台股走勢就像雲霄飛車，想上車心臟得要夠大顆，而也因為指數波動劇烈，周一財委會上有立委關心國際股市有熔斷機制，台灣是否也要啟動限空令、甚至禁空令？金管會主委彭金隆說除非市場失靈。

金管會主委 彭金隆：「如果說在這裡，多空有不同認知組合在做，沒有任何人為扭曲，我們當然尊重市場的機制。」

在國際股市影響下，台股19日一度大跌超過900點，台積電、聯發科等權值股同步下挫；被動元件族群更是重災區，信昌電開盤直接被打入跌停，龍頭股國巨也難逃狙擊。

好在指數在11點過後，隨著央行喊話、金管會穩軍心，跌幅明顯收斂。中信證券投顧指出，台股下檔實質基本面支撐不弱，投資人可以靜待美股止跌、新台幣止貶等止穩訊號浮現。富邦投顧董事長陳奕光則認為，如果大盤跌破季線，不用過度恐慌，反而是買點。

富邦投顧董事長 陳奕光：「我認為這禮拜應該是第四季整個行情裡面的低點，我覺得目前看起來的急跌的這樣的一個速度，其實是有的。我覺得接下來就是觀察今天晚上的融資，假如今天晚上的融資能夠減少50億以上的話，其實這個部分有達到這個所謂的籌碼清洗的效果，這是第一個。目前看起來外資今天應該還是狂賣，因為今天台幣還是呈現貶值，然後權值股還是呈現下跌。禮拜四我們認為說，在期指結算完之後，整個行情應該就會回歸基本面。」

尤其基期較低的非電族群，像金融及原物料都有補漲機會，只是台股短線能否止跌回穩，成交量將是觀察重點。（記者黃友柔、謝隆証／台北採訪報導）

news.Content:
（下午4點28分更新買賣超個股）

美股科技股賣壓和美國通膨升溫隱憂席捲全球，三大法人今（19）日合計賣超899.55億元，其中外資再砍767.43億元，重砍力積電（6770）4萬6,465張居冠，權王台積電（2330）雖未擠進賣超前十大，仍遭外資提款近238億元，鴻海（2317）也被調節逾1.4萬張，兩大電子權值股合計失血超過273億元。

外資賣超前三大：力積電、0050、 台玻

外資賣超榜由力積電（6770）以4萬6,465張高居第一，成為今日最大提款標的；ETF元大台灣50（0050）遭賣超3萬6,892張，排名第二；台玻（1802）則遭調節2萬9,813張，排名第三。

電子股方面，金寶（2312）也遭外資賣超1萬5,609張，排名第七；鴻海（2317）遭調節1萬4,884張，排名第八，以收盤價239.5元估算，外資單日賣超金額約35.65億元；記憶體廠旺宏（2337）則遭賣超1萬3,979張，排名第九。

值得注意的是，權王台積電雖未入列賣超前十大，但仍遭外資賣超9,834張，排名第13名，以收盤價2,420元計算，單日提款金額高達237.98億元。與鴻海兩大電子權值股合計遭外資提款約273.63億元。

外資買超前三大：中鋼、友達、 泰金寶-DR

反觀外資買超榜，鋼鐵龍頭中鋼（2002）獲外資買超1萬21張，拿下今日買超冠軍，也是唯一買超突破萬張的標的；面板大廠友達（2409）獲搶進8,761張，排名第二；泰金寶-DR（9105）則獲買超6,718張，排名第三，成為外資逆勢加碼的焦點。

其餘買超標的以傳產及民生消費股為主，食品大廠統一（1216）獲買超6,665張，排名第四；製鞋大廠寶成（9904）獲加碼5,744張，排名第六；營建股興富發（2542）獲買超4,900張，排名第七；統一超（2912）及化工廠和益（1709）則分別獲買超4,194張、3,843張，分居第八及第十名。

外資再砍767億元 連9日提款台股逾7585億元

根據證交所公布籌碼動向，三大法人今日延續賣超態勢，合計賣超899.55億元，其中外資再砍767.43億元，呈連9賣，累計賣超7585.25億元。

投信今日買超230.51億元，呈連7買，累計買超1141.84億元。

自營商則合計賣超362.63億元，其中自行買賣賣超60.23億元，避險操作賣超302.4億元。

國際油價與美債殖利率居高不下，市場憂心企業成本攀升及AI投資前景，台股今日盤中一度重挫逾940點，被動元件與記憶體族群賣壓較重，隨低接買盤進場、台積電（2330）尾盤拉回平盤，大盤跌幅逐步收斂，終場下跌289.18點，收在46,822.08點，失守4萬7關卡，但仍守住季線，成交金額縮至約8,644.44億元。

匯市同步遭到重擊，新台幣兌美元匯率今日盤中貶破32.5元關卡，貶值幅度超過2角。

分析師：盯緊期貨空單

資深證券分析師呂漢威表示，外資近期在期貨與現貨市場的布局均偏空，期貨淨空單雖由前一交易日的93,675口降至今日的91,145口，仍維持在相對高檔。台股今日盤中一度重挫逾900點，走勢有利於先前建立的期貨空單，若相關部位獲利，可能抵銷部分現貨部位的跌價損失。

呂漢威提醒，本周台指期即將結算，若結算前後外資期貨淨空單能降至8萬口以下，現貨賣壓就有機會減輕。

呂漢威補充，投信目前仍朝買進方向操作，與外資不同調，也是觀察本土資金承接力道的重點；自營商則以避險部位占大宗，可能涉及認售權證等商品操作。

馮萱榕／財經特派記者，主跑財政部、電腦通路、觀光餐飲等

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》CPO/矽光子共同封裝—AVGO、CRDO、COHR
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-19 14:18:40 數位內容中心 發佈

NVIDIA Corporation（NVDA.US）

10月於2026年OCP Global Summit，NVIDIA把下一代Vera Rubin AI平台的機架與托盤設計貢獻給OCP，並與Meta、Google、Cisco推進開放式資料中心標準。這次動作聚焦機架、背板與網路介面標準化，連結後續光電共同封裝與高密度光互連導入。

Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd（CRDO.US）

10月12日，Credo發布1.6T ZeroFlap主動光纜，最遠支援50公尺、每端功耗12瓦，並在OCP同步展示1.6T光收發器、主動電纜與Cardinal DSP加矽光子整合模組。訊號是其1.6T布局已從線纜延伸到矽光子模組與系統互連。

Broadcom Inc.（AVGO.US）

10月12日，Broadcom隨Celestica發表DS6005資料中心交換器，採Tomahawk 6－Davisson共同封裝光學平台，交換容量102.4Tbps，並整合可現場更換的外部雷射模組。公司同時指出，Tomahawk 6相較前代51.2T平台，在光互連情境下可再降低約40%功耗與延遲。

Celestica Inc.（CLS.US）

10月12日，Celestica公布DS6005資料中心交換器，機箱尺寸1.5OU，適配OCP ORv3機櫃，並整合液冷、可現場更換的外部雷射模組與CPO感知軟體管理。這項發布把共同封裝光學從元件驗證推進到可部署的資料中心系統形態。

Coherent Corp.（COHR.US）

在ECOC，Coherent展示3.2T 2xDR4收發器與6.4T近封裝光學（NPO）光引擎，後者整合矽光子與外部雷射插拔模組（ELSFPs），並同步推出供CPO使用的可拆式FAU連接器。這次重點不是單一模組，而是把NPO、ELS與CPO周邊連接方案一起端出。

Semtech Corporation（SMTC.US）

10月13日，Semtech宣布擴大與Tower Semiconductor的多年合作，將投資取得SiGe專屬產能，支援AI資料中心光互連元件需求。官方明確點名800G、1.6T與3.2T三個速度節點，且Semtech近期224Gbps每通道TIA產品線拿下ECOC 2026元件創新獎。

Tower Semiconductor Ltd.（TSEM.US）

10月13日，Tower Semiconductor與Semtech擴大多年合作，保留美國、以色列與日本晶圓廠的SiGe產能，對應800G、1.6T與3.2T光互連元件。這項安排直接指向高速光電前端量產能力，而非單一實驗室技術展示。

Super Micro Computer, Inc.（SMCI.US）

Supermicro擴大OCP Accepted產品組合，新增2OU CPO Switch，採Broadcom Tomahawk 6，交換容量102.4Tbps，提供128個800G連接埠，並整合48V DC匯流排與盲插液冷。公司把共同封裝光學交換器納入機櫃級部署架構，訊號是CPO正被包進整體資料中心方案。

Applied Materials, Inc.（AMAT.US）

Applied Materials宣布投入50億美元成立設備與製程創新及商業化研發中心EPIC Center，並集結三星電子、SK海力士與台積電等業者。就本週主題來看，這筆投資對應的是設備、材料、異質整合與封裝製程協同開發能力的提前卡位。

Voyant Photonics

10月13日，Voyant Photonics宣布將開發面向AI資料中心網路的晶片級光路交換引擎，基礎來自其已在FMCW光達平台工業化的矽光子切換架構。公司強調可支援極大量切換週期，並正調整封裝、測試性與光損等系統設計項目。

news.Content:

news.Title: Amazon.com vs. Walmart: Which Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
news.Content:
Is the digital cloud giant or the global retail king a better fit for your portfolio? Deciding between Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) and Walmart (NASDAQ:WMT) requires weighing high-growth tech against steady brick-and-mortar stability.

Amazon leads in e-commerce and cloud computing, while Walmart dominates the physical retail landscape with its massive grocery presence. Both companies are now blurring these lines, competing fiercely in online delivery and advertising. Understanding their different financial profiles is essential for deciding which path suits your investment goals in 2026.

The case for Amazon

Amazon operates a diverse business ecosystem, including online stores, third-party seller services, and an advertising platform. Its powerful Amazon Web Services segment provides cloud infrastructure and machine learning capabilities to enterprises, while the company also manages a $309.5 million class action settlement involving customer refunds. Navigating these complexities is central to managing a global workforce of 1.5 million employees among retail stocks .

In the fiscal year ended Dec. 31, 2025, according to its latest annual report, revenue reached nearly $716.9 billion, representing a growth of approximately 12.4% compared with the prior fiscal year. This expansion was accompanied by a net income of roughly $77.7 billion.

Amazon has total cash of $122.9 billion against total debt of $251.6 billion. It also has a total debt-to-equity ratio of 45.6%, and its 12-month trailing operating cash flow is $161.4 billion.

The case for Walmart

Walmart serves approximately 280 million customers weekly through a vast network of physical stores and an expanding e-commerce presence. The company is currently integrating AI and supply chain automation to improve its omnichannel strategy. It also offers financial services by collaborating with partners like Mastercard (NYSE:MA) to provide credit cards to its members.

In the fiscal year ended Jan. 31, 2026, as reported in its most recent annual filing, revenue reached close to $713.2 billion, a 4.7% increase year over year. The majority of these net sales were generated by the company's domestic Walmart U.S. and Sam's Club U.S. operations. For this period, the company reported net income of approximately $21.9 billion.

Walmart has total cash of $11.5 billion compared to total debt of $75 billion. Its total debt-to-equity ratio is 71.6%, and its 12-month trailing operating cash flow is $42.9 billion.

Risk profile comparison

Amazon.com faces intense global competition across retail, advertising, and cloud services where rivals often possess localized advantages or greater resources. International operations in regions like China and India carry risks of regulatory and ownership constraints that could disrupt the business model. Additionally, the company manages significant legal challenges including antitrust proceedings from the Federal Trade Commission and risks related to its complex global fulfillment networks.

Story Continues

Walmart operates in a highly competitive retail landscape against global omnichannel retailers and wholesale clubs that utilize advanced shopping platforms. The company faces operational vulnerabilities in its complex information systems. Furthermore, reliance on international manufacturing exposes its operating margin to tariffs, trade barriers, and geopolitical instability across the countries where it operates.

Valuation comparison

Deciding depends on whether you prefer Walmart's lower price-to-sales (P/S) ratio, or Amazon's lower forward price-to-earnings (P/E).

Which stock would I buy in 2026?

I like both of these stocks and believe that both have room in a portfolio. Walmart is more of a classic retailer than Amazon, with nearly 11,000 stores and clubs in 19 countries. Being a traditional retailer, however, hasn't stopped it from tapping into technology to meet the needs of more customers. It's seeing solid results with its AI shopping assistant, Sparky, as customers who use the AI agent spend 40% more than those who don't. Walmart is also seeing a boost in its online sales, with its global e-commerce sales up 23% in the second quarter of its fiscal 2027.

Still, if I had to pick only one stock to own between the two, I would choose Amazon. It just has more upside potential thanks to its role as an infrastructure backbone for AI. According to Statista, as of the first quarter of 2026, Amazon was the global leader in the cloud market, with 28% of the market share. It's also developing its own chips, and it has a stake in the AI start-up Anthropic, which is expected to go public soon. As the global AI market is valued at more than $707 billion in 2026 and is expected to jump to $1.9 trillion by 2032, Amazon is positioned to be a winner, offering greater potential for stock price appreciation than Walmart.

news.Title: Sam Altman praises the Tesla Roadster he gave up on
news.Content: Business rivals rarely clap for each other in public. When they do, the applause usually tells you more about the moment than about the product. Elon Musk and Sam Altman have spent years proving the point. The two co-founded OpenAI, split over its direction and then took their fight to X, to the courts and to the race to build the most powerful AI models. Their feud even reached Musk's car company. In 2025, Altman posted about trying to cancel the Tesla Roadster reservation he made in 2018, and Musk fired back by accusing Altman of stealing a nonprofit, TechCrunch reported. So the post that showed up on Altman's X account at midday on Friday, Oct. 16, caught people off guard. "Wow the new roadster looks quite amazing, good job @elonmusk," Altman wrote , a day after Tesla (TSLA) revealed the long-delayed sports car at a SpaceX test site in Texas. Altman's own Roadster saga started in 2018 Altman paid a $50,000 reservation fee for a Roadster in 2018, according to TechCrunch . When he tried to cancel last fall, his email to Tesla bounced, and he shared screenshots of the saga on X. More on Musk and Altman: Elon Musk, Tesla face serious new threat Elon Musk makes shocking admission about Sam Altman and OpenAI OpenAI makes development moves to counter SpaceX and Meta He said he had been really excited about the car but that seven and a half years had felt like a long wait. Musk replied that the problem was fixed and Altman was refunded within 24 hours, a claim TechCrunch noted it had not independently confirmed. That history makes Friday's post read as more than a polite compliment. Altman is praising a product he personally walked away from. Trump and Pichai also cheered the reveal The Roadster drew applause from people who rarely agree with Musk, or with each other. President Donald Trump called the car very impressive, Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai sent his congratulations and Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis posted a one-word "Wow!", according to a Washington Post report republished by The Peninsula . Related: Zuckerberg, Musk, and Huang take key stand on huge AI issue Pichai went a step further, joking that a self-driving version of the car would be something to see, Stocktwits reported on Yahoo Finance . I couldn't find a public reply from Musk to Altman's post as of Saturday morning, Oct. 17. Given the history, the silence is notable on its own. Why the Musk-Altman legal feud still matters to investors The legal fight is not over. On May 18, a federal jury in Oakland, Calif., ruled unanimously against Musk, finding he had waited too long to sue, Al Jazeera reported. Musk had sued over Altman's taking OpenAI from a not-for-profit to a hybrid structure. Story Continues Here's where things stand, according to court coverage: Musk sought up to $134 billion in what he called ill-gotten gains, plus the removal of Altman and OpenAI President Greg Brockman, The Decoder reported. Musk called the outcome a "calendar technicality" and said he would appeal to the Ninth Circuit, the same outlet reported. Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers said substantial evidence supported the jury's finding, signaling an uphill appeal, according to Al Jazeera . The rivalry has also moved closer to Tesla's core business. OpenAI launched a dedicated robotics division on May 31, TheStreet reported, putting it on a collision course with Tesla's Optimus humanoid robot program. In my analysis, that's why a friendly post from Altman deserves a second look from Tesla shareholders. Competitors praise a product most easily when they don't see it as a threat to their own plans. The refund lesson for anyone eyeing a deposit Altman got his money back, but most buyers don't have a public platform and a billionaire rival reading their posts. Tesla has now reopened Roadster reservations with terms that look a lot like the ones Altman signed up for. The Performance version asks for $5,000 up front and $45,000 more within ten days, Electrek reported. Tesla still hasn't announced a price, and it targets production in 2028. If you put $50,000 down, you're lending Tesla money with no interest and no delivery date. Altman waited seven and a half years before asking for his back. Tesla earnings and Musk's appeal come next Tesla reports third-quarter results after the close on Wednesday, Oct. 21. The stock fell 2.13% to $354.72 on Friday as early enthusiasm over the Roadster faded, The Motley Fool reported. Musk's appeal will take months, and the trash talk could return at any point. For now, the most public reconciliation between the two came from a ten-word post about a car Altman gave up waiting for. A compliment costs nothing. A $50,000 deposit costs plenty, and Altman knows the difference better than most. news.Title: CoreWeave, Oracle have an interest rate problem
news.Content:
It started with one chart and one word.

Late on Oct. 13, tech investor Chamath Palihapitiya posted a chart showing CoreWeave bond yields at a new high. Elon Musk replied with a single word: "Yikes."

By the next morning, the whole AI trade was left wobbling.

Over the past 18 months, CoreWeave and AI infrastructure peers have been investing heavily in the data center buildout. These capital expenditures were funded with debt.

Now investors are extremely wary, as interest rates are about to tick higher.

Why rising rates hit AI borrowers hardest

AI companies have borrowed at a record pace.

CNBC reported that Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Oracle had issued more than $228 billion in bonds as of Oct. 13, more than double the total in all of 2025.

Also Read : Barclays resets Oracle stock price target

JPMorgan expects the big cloud companies, known as hyperscalers, to spend $800 billion this year and more than $1 trillion a year by 2027, most of which is financed with debt.

Reuters reported that the latest inflation data will translate to rate hikes, driving interest expenses higher for CoreWeave (CRWV) and other data center firms with debt-heavy balance sheets.

A bond yield is the return investors demand. When yields rise, prices fall, and a higher yield also means the market forecasts more risk.

"The era of easy money … is starting to disappear and dissipate," Luis Alvarado of Wells Fargo Investment Institute told CNBC.

CoreWeave's interest bill, explained

CoreWeave is where the squeeze shows up first. Its June quarter numbers tell the story:

Revenue : $2.6 billion, up 112.5% from a year earlier.

Interest expense : $640 million, up from $267 million last year.

Operating margin : negative 1.9%, so roughly break-even.

Net loss : $626 million, or $1.14 per share.

Debt : $27.6 billion long-term, plus $7.5 billion due within a year, against $5.5 billion in cash.

Sales doubled, yet interest expense accounted for roughly 25% of revenue.

Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA) stood at $1.3 billion, which covers the interest expense twice.

CNBC reported that S&P Credit Ratings rates CoreWeave B+, which is junk territory. Its five-year credit default swaps, a form of insurance against default, topped 1,140 basis points at one point.

Related: CoreWeave CEO responds as worry over spending bill comes due

Gavan Nolan of S&P Global Market Intelligence said 1,000 or higher generally signals credit distress.

Shares fell 15.5% on Oct. 14 and tumbled 24% last week.

CEO Mike Intrator pushed back in a memo obtained by CNBC, stating:

Story Continues

"We are confident in our backlog which more than supports all of our debt obligations."

Deutsche Bank said the backlog tops $100 billion, with about two-thirds tied to investment-grade customers such as Microsoft and Meta.

Oracle has more cushion, but less room

Oracle's (ORCL) balance sheet looks stronger.

In its August quarter , revenue hit $19.3 billion, up 29.6%, while operating profit stood at $6.7 billion.

Its interest expense rose roughly 50% year over year to $1.4 billion. So, operating profit covers the interest almost five times.

Investing.com reported that S&P Global Ratings cut Oracle to BBB- in July, one notch above junk.

S&P sees a fiscal 2027 free cash flow deficit of $42 billion, and Oracle carries $167 billion in total debt.

Oracle shares fell nearly 10% last week and trade 61% below all-time highs.

My take on the AI debt scare

CoreWeave has contracts with the biggest names in tech, and Oracle has a $664 billion backlog.

However, CoreWeave will have to improve profit margins to manage interest expenses over time.

Given consensus estimates compiled by TIKR , CoreWeave is forecast to report a cumulative free cash flow of over $90 billion through 2029. It is projected to report a free cash flow of $10 billion in 2030.

CoreWeave will be forced to raise capital multiple times to support its cash burn rate and data center expansion plans.

More Artificial Intelligence:

AI's biggest business opportunity may not look like AI

AI racks are outgrowing old power: 2 chipmakers have a strategy

BofA splits software into winners and losers as AI agents arrive

Companies can raise money via debt or equity. Debt will impact profitability, whereas equity results in shareholder dilution.

Meanwhile, Oracle is projected to report a free cash outflow of $70 billion over the next two years.

Its free cash flow is then forecast to expand from $6.3 billion in fiscal 2029 (ending in May) to $49 billion in 2031.

Of the two, I see CoreWeave as the more fragile, given Oracle is much bigger, with stronger fundamentals.

The AI buildout is not broken. In fact, both CoreWeave and Oracle are investing heavily in capex to support demand.

However, building data centers costs billions, and much of that money is borrowed and could get more expensive.

Right now, investors want proof that cash flow can pay the interest bills.

news.Title: Cramer points to rare Reddit buy opportunity amid Google AI threat
news.Content:
Things have been rough for Reddit (RDDT) recently. The stock is down about 34% in 2026, and it closed at $159.36 on Thursday, which is well below its 52-week high of $263.50.

However, Jim Cramer thinks that drop is a good chance to buy the stock.

According to CNBC , on the October 15 Lightning Round of Mad Money, he said, "I want to buy Reddit. I think the stock is inexpensive." Here's why Cramer is recommending the stock despite the drop.

Why Cramer thinks Reddit's drop is a buying chance

Reddit runs a large discussion site, and it makes most of its money by selling ads inside its communities. In addition to that, it now sells access to its library of posts to help AI companies train their models. That's good business, considering how the AI market is booming. And the results are starting to show in its earnings.

Also read: Jim Cramer noticed something odd about the stock market

In its second quarter of 2026, Reddit said its revenue increased by 61% from a year earlier to $805 million , and its net income more than doubled to $253 million , according to its SEC filing. That was the eighth quarter in a row of over 60% revenue growth.

Cramer said back in September that a buyer could pay up to $40 billion for Reddit's texts alone, since AI companies are hungry for the real human conversations that live on Reddit, Yahoo Finance reported.

The Google AI problem that's scaring investors

Have you ever asked Google for an honest review or recommendation about something? If you have, there's a good chance a Reddit thread popped up among the search options. Viewing that thread turns into page views and ad money for Reddit.

However, during Reddit's second-quarter earnings call, CEO Steve Huffman said "Search referrals were choppy in the quarter, and traffic was more volatile later in the quarter," Yahoo Finance reported. The problem is that Google AI now answers questions directly on the search page, so fewer people need to click on the Reddit link.

More Cramer Coverage:

Jim Cramer says he's willing to stick his neck out for this stock

'I think you should own it,' Cramer says of surging energy stock

Cramer pours cold water on Rocket Companies before earnings

Reddit has previously said about half of its traffic comes from Google search referrals, so any slowdown there would show up quickly in the ad business.

Also, some volunteer moderators have complained that the content they help manage is being sold to AI firms through licensing deals, with none of the money going to them. If moderators keep pushing back, the ad engine could lose some of the momentum that is powering Reddit's results today.

Story Continues

What everyday investors should think about before buying

Cramer has valid reasons for his call, but investors should still consider a few things. If Google's AI search keeps satisfying people faster than Reddit's AI data deals can replace the lost ad money, the company could still miss profit targets next year even if its total sales keep increasing.

Based on my analysis, Reddit is still a volatile stock, so if you want to buy in now, consider spreading out your purchase so a bad period won't affect your whole investment. In fact, Cramer called Reddit "ridiculously cheap" when it was near $166 back in August, and the shares have actually dropped a bit lower since that time. That's why it's never a bad idea to be a bit cautious.
